tweets.html: Mitch Bratt becomes the 2nd rookie pitcher in Arizona D-backs history to pitch at least 7 shutout innings and permit 1 or no hits with at least eight strikeouts: 7-1-0-0-3-9.The only other rookie to accomplish the feat in franchise history was Zac Gallen in 2019, also vs. SD.

tweets.author: Bob Nightengale
tweets.html: That's it for Casey Mize, who's yanked after just 3 1/3 innings in his Padres' debut after 11-day layoff.He gives up 9 hits (including 5 in a row) and 5 runs with 3 walks and a strikeout, departing with two runners on base.He induced just 2 swings and misses in his 77 pitches.
